svg.text: [*] Two speeds: at some points the samples ran at two clearly different speeds, so the line splits in two there. The rarer speed is drawn fainter,
in proportion to how rarely it occurred. A common cause is a chip with performance cores and slower efficiency cores: the operating system runs the work
on either kind. Two copies sharing one unit of the chip, and a virtual machine whose host moves it between cores, split speeds too.

svg.text: BLAKE3 servil · One message per call · AVX-512 compression from the start: Inputs of one chunk (1 KiB) or less run one compression per block on the calling platform's compress
BLAKE3 servil · One message per call · AVX-512 hash_many (16-way) from 1025 B: Above one chunk the tree is hashed several chunks at a time, up to the platform's SIMD degree per
BLAKE3 servil · Many 64-byte messages per call · AVX-512 compression from the start: A single message is one compression on the calling platform's compress kernel.
BLAKE3 servil · Many 64-byte messages per call · AVX-512 hash_many (16-way) from 128 B: Two or more one-block messages are compressed together, up to the platform's SIMD degree
BLAKE3 servil · One message, streamed in 64 KiB pieces · AVX-512 compression from the start: Inputs of one chunk (1 KiB) or less run one compression per block on the calling
BLAKE3 servil · One message, streamed in 64 KiB pieces · AVX-512 hash_many (16-way) from 1025 B: Above one chunk the tree is hashed several chunks at a time, up to the platform's
BLAKE3 servil mt · One message per call · AVX-512 compression from the start: Inputs of one chunk (1 KiB) or less run one compression per block on the calling platform's compress
BLAKE3 servil mt · One message per call · AVX-512 hash_many (16-way) from 1025 B: Above one chunk the tree is hashed several chunks at a time, up to the platform's SIMD degree per
BLAKE3 servil mt · One message per call · subtrees over threads from 64 KiB: From here calls may cut the input at subtree boundaries into pieces of 8 KiB to 128 KiB, shrinking
toward the end, that the calling thread and this crate's worker threads (one per CPU beyond the first) hash at once, each on the NEON hybrid kernels, which run at full speed on
every core at once; the caller merges the chaining values. Concurrent callers' pieces are served in turn; when callers already fill the CPUs, a new call hashes its input whole
BLAKE3 servil mt · Many 64-byte messages per call · AVX-512 compression from the start: A single message is one compression on the calling platform's compress kernel.
BLAKE3 servil mt · Many 64-byte messages per call · AVX-512 hash_many (16-way) from 128 B: Two or more one-block messages are compressed together, up to the platform's SIMD degree
BLAKE3 servil mt · Many 64-byte messages per call · message ranges over threads from 64 KiB: From here a batch is cut into ranges of messages of 8 KiB to 128 KiB, shrinking toward
the end, that the calling thread and this crate's worker threads hash at once, each range on the NEON hybrid kernels, which run at full speed on every core at once. Concurrent
callers' ranges are served in turn; when callers already fill the CPUs, a new call hashes its batch whole on its own thread.
BLAKE3 servil mt · One message, streamed in 64 KiB pieces · AVX-512 compression from the start: Inputs of one chunk (1 KiB) or less run one compression per block on the calling
BLAKE3 servil mt · One message, streamed in 64 KiB pieces · AVX-512 hash_many (16-way) from 1025 B: Above one chunk the tree is hashed several chunks at a time, up to the
BLAKE3 servil mt · One message, streamed in 64 KiB pieces · subtrees over threads from 64 KiB: From here calls may cut the input at subtree boundaries into pieces of 8 KiB to 128
KiB, shrinking toward the end, that the calling thread and this crate's worker threads (one per CPU beyond the first) hash at once, each on the NEON hybrid kernels, which run at
full speed on every core at once; the caller merges the chaining values. Concurrent callers' pieces are served in turn; when callers already fill the CPUs, a new call hashes its
input whole on its own thread.
